stories.headline: Jensen Huang Said Nvidia Now Has "a Lot Greater Visibility" Into Demand, Letting It Forecast a Full Year Ahead for the First Time Ever. Does That Confidence Justify Nvidia's Premium Valuation?
stories.body: Key PointsNvidia stock trades at a forward P/E above 25, while the S&P 500 has a forward P/E of roughly 19.

stories.headline: Citi Wealth Sees Long Runway for AI Spending Despite Bubble Warnings
stories.body: The artificial intelligence buildout is still in its early-to-middle stages, Citi Wealth said in a report released Wednesday (Oct. 7). The AI investment cycle is facing greater scrutiny due to higher interest rates, increasingly capable open-weight models, regulatory pressure and rising infrastructure costs, the bank said in the report. stories.headline: New data flips the script on winning rollover business
stories.body: While rollover assets increase with retirement savers' age, many rollover transactions occur well before retirement, according to new data and a panel of six experts. For financial advisors, that presents a potential business opportunity.
